name: 整列頁首＋標誌左、導覽與輸入框和圖示按鈕靠右，手機改底部分頁列
desc: 橫跨全寬、固定在畫面頂端的頁首。標誌在左，導覽連結、短輸入框與一組圖示按鈕依序靠右，內容延伸到接近畫面左右邊緣；目前頁面的導覽項目下方有小圓點。手機版導覽改為固定在畫面底部的一列分頁按鈕。
prompt: 建立一個橫跨整個畫面寬的頁首列，固定在畫面頂端：標誌在左，導覽連結與功能區靠右，所有元素在同一水平線上垂直置中；內容不受頁面內容寬度限制，左右延伸到接近畫面邊緣，只留少許邊距。標誌明顯大於導覽連結，標誌右側可放一段小字，沒有時省略。右側由左到右依序是導覽連結和功能區；功能區可放一個短輸入框與一組圖示按鈕，圖示按鈕可帶小型數字標記，沒有時省略；輸入框和圖示按鈕群組之間的間距大於導覽連結之間。目前所在頁面的導覽項目下方有一個小圓點標記。往下或往上捲動時頁首都不隱藏，高度與排列不變。
mobile: 頁首仍是整列，標誌在左，標誌旁的小字保留；右側可放一個短輸入框，沒有時省略。導覽改為固定在畫面底部的一列分頁按鈕：數個「圖示加短文字」的分頁按鈕等寬排列，分頁之間有直向分隔線，整列上緣有一條分隔線；導覽連結與功能區的圖示按鈕移進這一列，最右邊一格是選單按鈕，點選單按鈕後打開放有其餘導覽連結的選單面板。觸控裝置上取消滑過效果，只保留目前頁面的小圓點標記。

en.name: Full-width header bar + logo left, navigation, input and icon buttons on the right, bottom tab bar on mobile
en.desc: A full-width header fixed to the top of the viewport. The logo is on the left, and the navigation links, a short input field and a group of icon buttons follow in order on the right, extending close to the left and right edges of the viewport; the navigation item for the current page has a small dot below it. On mobile the navigation becomes a row of tab buttons fixed to the bottom of the viewport.
en.prompt: Create a header bar spanning the full width of the viewport, fixed to the top of the viewport, with the logo on the left, with the navigation links and the actions group on the right, all elements vertically centered on the same horizontal line; the content is not limited to the page content width and extends close to the left and right edges of the viewport, keeping only a small margin. The logo is clearly larger than the navigation links; optionally place a short piece of small text to the right of the logo, omitted when there is no content. On the right, from left to right, come the navigation links and then the actions group; optionally place a short input field and a group of icon buttons in the actions group, and the icon buttons may carry a small number badge; omit them when there is no content. The gap between the input field and the icon button group is larger than the gaps between navigation links. The navigation item for the current page has a small dot marker below it. The header never hides, whether scrolling down or up, and its height and arrangement do not change.
en.mobile: The header stays a full-width bar with the logo on the left, keeping the small text next to it; optionally place a short input field on the right, omitted when there is no content. Navigation becomes a row of tab buttons fixed to the bottom of the viewport: several tab buttons, each an icon with short text, are arranged at equal widths, with vertical dividers between tabs and a divider along the top edge of the row; the navigation links and the icon buttons from the actions group move into this row, and the rightmost cell is the menu button, which opens a menu panel holding the remaining navigation links. On touch devices the hover effect is removed, and only the small dot marker for the current page remains.

extras.name: 導覽連結滑過出現小圓點
extras.prompt: 滑鼠滑過頁首的導覽連結時，該項目下方出現一個小圓點標記，移開後消失；目前所在頁面的圓點標記保持不變。
extras.mobile: 觸控裝置上取消滑過效果。

en.name: Small dot on navigation link hover
en.prompt: When the mouse hovers over a navigation link in the header, a small dot marker appears below that item and disappears when the pointer leaves; the dot marker for the current page stays unchanged.
en.mobile: The hover effect is removed on touch devices.
